# napcat-sdk

Temporary placeholder llms.txt.

Detailed LLM-oriented guidance was removed and will be rewritten later.
For now:
- Use `napcat-sdk doc apis` to inspect available APIs.
- Use `napcat-sdk doc api <NAME>` to inspect an API signature and related types.
- Use `napcat-sdk doc files`, `napcat-sdk doc code <PATH>`, and `napcat-sdk doc class <NAME>` for source lookup.

This file exists only to keep temporary compatibility with existing tooling.
